basis: Owner permits unattended routing after stable mechanical interfaces; completed exact all-front assembly now supports that interface.
constraints: Create a separate printed-bell-routing native candidate; preserve the published stage-1 board and its mechanical bind.
Keep all footprint poses, local pad rotations, libraries, board/mount/USB/contact geometry and schematic nets unchanged.
Rebind the mechanical artifacts to the final routed candidate's exact bytes, even for copper-only changes.
Add useful B-side polarity/orientation silk without adding copper or moving contacts.
Avoid both raw contact nets and contact-base projections with protected-GND vias/pours; do not bridge CELL_NEG to GND.
Route genuine critical connections and validate native connectivity/clearances; an intent list is not completed routing.
Do not waive existing USB hole clearances or silently select a high-current/USB-impedance safety rating.
If a footprint or mechanical datum must move, obtain a new coordinated review before adopting it.
No fabrication, purchase, live-cell use or child-use qualification is granted.
